scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance a three-dimensional Gray–Scott reaction-diffusion system with explicit Euler and discrete zero-flux boundaries.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: A_t=Da Lap(A)−A B²+F(1−A); B_t=Db Lap(B)+A B²−(F+k)B, with source Cartesian second differences and a repeated-center ghost value at each outer face. Each timestep retains six pencil derivative launches, two Laplacian assemblies, reaction and Euler update.
scientific_intent.discretization: Four short-time cubic fixtures:16³ nonuniform5steps,32³ central10³ unperturbed patch4steps,16³ exactA1/B0 equilibrium3steps,16³ affineA/B0 diffusion-only1step. Source pencils2, Da=.16,Db=.08,dx=.5,dt=.25,F=.0392,k=.0649; diffusion-only control explicitlyF=k=0.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Complete nine final fields versus independent Float64 global-neighbor Euler oracle with fixed1e-6+5e-6relative; exact equilibrium, actual initialA/B bits and576guards, finite nonnegative species, zero-flux mean diffusion<=1e-6 and diffusion-only mean mass conservation<=1e-6. All fields compare with both GPU references.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Named short-time16³/32³ fixtures,13timesteps/130launches. No default128³×10000step CLI, periodic boundary branch, pattern morphology, calibrated chemical prediction or continuum grid/time convergence certificate.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 concentration/scratch/coefficients, independent Float64 operator using actualF32 initial values and parameters. Source F32(F+k) differs from F64 coefficient addition within the declared engineering budget. Full per-field absolute/budget/field-norm and nonzero-reference-relative errors retained; near-zero absolute floor is not physical accuracy.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Gray–Scott is a reaction-diffusion pattern-formation model. The source provides a finite numerical operator, not a calibrated chemical experiment; domain users need boundary, timestep, positivity and discretization checks beyond agreement of min/max statistics.
scientific_intent.description: Historical Julia genuinely implemented zero-flux Gray–Scott mathematics but fused every timestep into one kernel with a different random-input generator. Current versions restore the original staged pencil pipeline so timing compares the same algorithm and buffers.
scientific_intent.provenance: Native main.cu kinetic parameters and pipeline, kernels.cu Gray–Scott/axis derivatives/Laplacian/Euler update, util.h central cube generator. Standard equation identity follows the explicit source rate expressions; no application experiment or primary paper inferred.
